title: Bob Dylan - Most Likely You Go Your Way (And I

lines.l: I can't beg you anymore, I'm gonna let you pass
And I'll go last
And time will tell just who has failed
And who's been left behind
When you go your way and I go mine
You say you disturbed me and you don't deserve me
But you know sometimes you lie
You say you're shaking and you're always aching
But you know how hard you try
Sometimes it gets so hard to care
Can't be this way everywhere
And I'm gonna let you pass
Yeah, it's not the last
But in time you tell
Who has failed
And who's been left behind
When you go your way and I don't mind
When the judge, he holds a grudge
He's gonna call on you
But he's fat, he builds, and he walks on stilts
Watch out, he don't fall on you
You say you're sorry for telling stories that you know I believe are true

Yes, and I'll go last

When you go, you're in, I don't mind
When I walked up 10th Street, turned down bail, looking for a gal at the car, Lucille, cocaine all around my brain.
